tr.td: Breathlessness on exertion for about two years, now after one flight of stairs or a block on the level (mMRC 2), with a morning cough and a little clear sputum most days; no chest pain, ankle swelling, orthopnea, wheeze at rest or weight loss; a former smoker of about 30 pack-years; cause under evaluation with spirometry and a pulmonology consultation
S — Synthetic presenting problem anchored to his documented emphysema; superseded when spirometry at the consultation confirmed COPD.
Former cigarette smoker, about 30 pack-years, stopped eleven years ago on his own; no use since
S — Synthetic smoking history: whether he smoked is not documented in the sources read, so the history is synthetic and labeled as such.
Hyperlipidemia: LDL 148 mg/dL, HDL 44 and triglycerides 160 at intake; estimated 10-year cardiovascular risk about 18 percent; atorvastatin started by shared decision
S — Synthetic cardiovascular risk factor anchored to his documented heart trouble; not a claim about his real lipids.

list.item: Breathlessness on exertion for about two years, now after one flight of stairs or a block on the level (mMRC 2), with a morning cough and a little clear sputum most days; no chest pain, ankle swelling, orthopnea, wheeze at rest or weight loss; a former smoker of about 30 pack-years; cause under evaluation with spirometry and a pulmonology consultation: active, confirmed [S]
Former cigarette smoker, about 30 pack-years, stopped eleven years ago on his own; no use since: active, confirmed [S]
Hyperlipidemia: LDL 148 mg/dL, HDL 44 and triglycerides 160 at intake; estimated 10-year cardiovascular risk about 18 percent; atorvastatin started by shared decision: active, confirmed [S]

Breathlessness work-up at intake: symptoms with the CAT and mMRC, exacerbation history over the past year, smoking history and examination; blood count with eosinophils, alpha-1 antitrypsin once, kidney function, HbA1c, lipids, NT-proBNP and a 12-lead ECG; resting oxygen saturation read with care in darker skin. Guideline: Global Strategy for the Prevention, Diagnosis and Management of COPD: 2025 Report (2025); Race and Ethnicity in Pulmonary Function Test Interpretation: An Official American Thoracic Society Statement (2023); CMID: Clinical Monitoring Intelligence Database, COPD and hyperlipidemia monographs (2026) [S]

Pulmonology consultation to confirm the diagnosis with spirometry, interpret it with race-neutral equations, and advise on treatment, oxygen and rehabilitation. Guideline: Global Strategy for the Prevention, Diagnosis and Management of COPD: 2025 Report (2025); Race and Ethnicity in Pulmonary Function Test Interpretation: An Official American Thoracic Society Statement (2023) [S]
Albuterol with a spacer as needed for breathlessness, with technique checked at the visit. Guideline: Global Strategy for the Prevention, Diagnosis and Management of COPD: 2025 Report (2025) [S]

Cardiovascular risk: moderate-intensity atorvastatin by shared decision, with a lipid panel at about eight weeks; blood pressure at each visit; ECG reviewed after any exacerbation. Guideline: Global Strategy for the Prevention, Diagnosis and Management of COPD: 2025 Report (2025); Statin Use for the Primary Prevention of Cardiovascular Disease in Adults: Preventive Medication (2022) [S]

Vaccines: PCV20 and Tdap now; influenza, RSV and COVID-19 in the autumn; recombinant zoster. Guideline: Global Strategy for the Prevention, Diagnosis and Management of COPD: 2025 Report (2025); Adult Immunization Schedule by Age (2026) [S]
